project.name: Building Safety Monitoring Assistant
project.description: A Python notebook prototype that analyses simulated structural sensor data and inspection report text to detect possible building safety risks.
project.purpose: Credit-level proof-of-concept for anomaly detection, risk scoring, and maintenance recommendation.

columns.name: timestamp
columns.description: Time when the sensor reading was recorded.

columns.name: vibration_mm_s
columns.description: Simulated vibration reading from a structure.

columns.name: inspection_report
columns.description: Simulated inspection note describing observed structural condition.

simulated_anomalies.name: high_vibration_and_tilt
simulated_anomalies.inspection_report: Increased vibration observed near support beam. Possible fatigue or loose connection.

simulated_anomalies.name: crack_widening_and_spalling
simulated_anomalies.inspection_report: Visible crack widening and minor spalling near concrete column. Further inspection recommended.

components.sensor_threshold_score: Score from vibration, tilt, and crack width thresholds.
components.is_anomaly: 1 if Isolation Forest detects anomaly, otherwise 0.
components.text_risk_score: Score from risk-related keywords in inspection report text.

risk_classification.recommended_action: Urgent inspection within 24–48 hours. Increase monitoring and consider restricting access until checked.
Schedule engineering inspection within 7 days and monitor the affected sensor readings more frequently.
Continue routine monitoring and normal periodic inspection.

visualisations: Building Safety Risk Score Over Time

example_input.inspection_report: Increased vibration and crack widening. Possible fatigue near support beam.

limitations: The dataset is simulated and not collected from real sensors.
The sensor thresholds are demonstration rules and should be replaced with engineering standards for real use.
The keyword text analysis is simple and could be improved with NLP or a retrieval-augmented generation system.
The prototype is a proof of concept and not a certified building safety system.
future_work: Connect the notebook to real IoT sensor data.
Add a dashboard for live monitoring.
Improve report analysis using NLP or LLM-based summarisation.
Validate thresholds with structural engineering standards.
